thread:
Camila Rivera: Quick sync — launch follow-up. Retention looks healthy (+6% WoW) but we've got a streaming latency regression reported by a few customers after yesterday's rollout. Need to decide whether next sprint is bug-first (streaming perf) or feature-first (dynamic batching UI). Quick takes?

Aran Patel: Streaming perf + SLA risk sounds urgent. Do we have repro steps/logs?

Camila Rivera: Repro in #incidents, tl;dr: 95th token latency jumped from ~240ms to ~480ms for sessions >1k tokens. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T18:22:01Z] req_id=abc123 model=redwood-7B seq_len=1200 95p_latency=480ms
```

Logan Miles: Might be KV cache eviction change from the rollout. I can investigate but ETA ~2d. If we block on fixing this, we should freeze unrelated changes.

Sarah Chen: The dynamic batching UI is ~5d of work but helps reduce unit cost ~12% for batch-heavy customers. That was top-requested in the roadmap poll.

Priya Kaur: Support says 3 customers reported severity=2; one is on Dedicated with an SLA — they want a fix.

Aran Patel: Tradeoffs: immediate SLA + churn risk vs strategic cost reduction. Proposal: do a canary rollback of the KV cache change as a hotfix and monitor 24h. If stable, prioritize batching UI next sprint. Agree?

Logan Miles: +1 if rollback low-risk. I can open the rollback PR today and trigger a canary. Need someone to own validation.

Camila Rivera: @Sarah can you own validation/customer outreach? Checklist: 1) deploy canary rollback, 2) perf test with seq_len ~1k, 3) notify the 3 customers, 4) promote if green.

Sarah Chen: I got this. Will coordinate with @DevOps Bot for canary deploy and alerting.

DevOps Bot: deploy canary rollback triggered by @Logan, build `service@rollback-kv-20260315` started. ETA ~18m. Will update with status.

Priya Kaur: I'll draft the customer note and hold escalation. Also calling out potential billing variance if we revert — finance might need a heads-up.

Camila Rivera: Decision: prioritize the hotfix this sprint (scope: rollback KV cache change only). Dynamic batching UI moves to next sprint as the top infra/product enhancement. Action owners: Logan (rollback PR + deploy), Sarah (validation + customer comms), Priya (customer messaging), Aran (monitoring + RCA). I'll update the roadmap board and link the tasks. :white_check_mark:

Logan Miles: Opening PR now. link: https://git.redwood/rollbacks/123

Sarah Chen: Will post perf numbers once canary perf run completes.

DevOps Bot: canary deploy succeeded — pods ready=6/6. Baseline perf run queued.

Camila Rivera: Thanks all. If canary is clean we'll promote and close this loop; otherwise we'll expand RCA. :sparkles:
